name: Nymph
languages: Elven, Sylvan Once benevolent faeries, now marked by a menacing, eerie glow.
description: Once benevolent faeries, now marked by a menacing, eerie glow.

abilities.name: Absorb Magick
abilities.description: When a nymph is affected by a non-white magick spell, it suffers no effect and instead gains an amount of temporary MP equal to the cost of the spell used. If this temporary MP is not used by the end of the encounter, it is lost.

abilities.name: Syphon Mana
abilities.description: As a primary action, nymphs can make a Spellcraft check against the Will Defence of a target within 12 squares and line of sight. If successful, the target loses 1d6 MP and the nymph gains an equal amount of MP . This die may explode. The nymph may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

name: Mandragora
languages: Sylvan Small, plant-like fae that emit ear-piercing shrieks before fleeing when spooked.
description: Small, plant-like fae that emit ear-piercing shrieks before fleeing when spooked.

abilities.name: Imitate
abilities.description: Mandragora can take 20 on Stealth checks when remaning still and can hide in plain sight.

abilities.name: Shriek
abilities.description: As a primary action, the mandragora can make an attack roll (d20+11) against the Will Defence of all enemies within a 4 square cone. If successful, the targets becomes confused. The mandragora may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This is a mind effect.

steal: 380gp (5%), Magick Herb (50%) Fae While many of Val’ daera's creatures are magickal in nature, none exemplify this as much as the fae, creatures born of the wild magicks of the Faewood. They oft frolic where nature thrives. Fae progress as beasts. However, they gain an amount of MP equal to 3+Mnd at each level and always treat Spellcraft as a class skill.

name: Pixie
languages: Common, Elven, Sylvan Generous faeries of the Lowlands, known to aid those pure of heart.
description: Generous faeries of the Lowlands, known to aid those pure of heart.

abilities.name: Absorb Magick
abilities.description: When a pixie is affected by a non-black magick spell, it suffers no effect and instead gains an amount of temporary MP equal to the cost of the spell used. If this temporary MP is not used by the end of the encounter, it is lost.

loot: Stardust (5%), Fae Wood (20%), Earth Crystal (50%), Magicite (95%)

name: Dryad
languages: Sylvan Said to be fallen druids, they defend the Faewood even in death.
description: Said to be fallen druids, they defend the Faewood even in death.

abilities.name: Swarmstrike
abilities.description: As a primary action, the dryad can make an attack (d20+14) against the Ref Defence of all enemies in a 4 square cone. If successful, creatures suffer 4d6+4 points of piercing damage and there is a 50% chance (50 or less on d%) the creatures are poisoned by widow’s kiss. Otherwise, creatures suffer half damage and are not poisoned. The dryad may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This is an area effect.

abilities.name: Tree Meld
abilities.description: When in jungles or forests, dryads may take 20 on Stealth checks and may hide in plain sight.

steal: Faerie Wand (5%), Pistoja Powder (20%), Golden Sap (50%)

name: Unicorn
languages: Sylvan Sacred fae of Val’ daera, revered as symbols of purity and grace.
description: Sacred fae of Val’ daera, revered as symbols of purity and grace.

abilities.name: Sacred Protectors
abilities.description: Fae creatures may reroll any attacks or Spellcraft checks against enemies threatening a unicorn, keeping the higher result.

name: Sylph
languages: Sylvan Higher fae who guard and guide the Faewood with unseen grace.
description: Higher fae who guard and guide the Faewood with unseen grace.

abilities.name: Absorb Magick
abilities.description: When a sylph is affected by a non-black magick spell, it suffers no effect and instead gains an amount of temporary MP equal to the cost of the spell used. If this temporary MP is not used by the end of the encounter, it is lost.

abilities.name: Kaleidoscope
abilities.description: When casting a single target spell that targets Will Defence, a sylph may choose to target all enemies within a 6 square cone, rather than the normal range.

loot: Moondust (5%), Hi-potion (20%), Fae Wood (50%), Golden Sap (95%)

name: Owlbear
description: Fierce fae beasts, fiercely protective and aggressive. Their enchanted feathers repel all magick.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.description: As a primary action, an owlbear may make an attack roll (d20+20) against the Fort Defence of all targets within a 6 square cone. If successful, targets take 6d6+10 slashing damage and are moved 2 squares directly away from the owlbear. Otherwise, targets take half damage and are not moved. Creatures that are 2 or more size categories larger than the owlbear ignore the forced movement, even upon success. The owlbear may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This is an area effect.

abilities.name: Magick Resistance
abilities.description: The owlbear gains a +5 bonus to all defences against spells.

steal: Golden Sap (5%), Great Feather (20%), Earth Crystal (95%) * Against spells.

name: Treant
languages: Elven, Sylvan In their final days, some druids enter a deep trance, allowing the Faewood to consume their bodies. What emerges is one of nature’s mightiest protectors.
description: In their final days, some druids enter a deep trance, allowing the Faewood to consume their bodies. What emerges is one of nature’s mightiest protectors.

abilities.name: Immovable*
abilities.description: The treant cannot be moved by any means of forced movement, including teleportation.

abilities.name: Lurk*
abilities.description: Treants blend into the canopy of trees around them. When in jungles or forests, treants treat Stealth as a trained skill and ignore any size penalties to Stealth checks.

abilities.name: Lob
abilities.description: Treants may make a slam attack as if using a thrown weapon. Additionally, they may use their Str modifier in place of their Agi modifier when doing so.

abilities.name: Regrow
abilities.description: When a treant loses a limb, they are able to grow it back in 1d10+1 days, at which point any penalties are removed.

abilities.name: Root
abilities.description: As a secondary action, a treant may root itself into the ground. While rooted, the treant’s movement speed is reduced to 0. Alternatively, if rooted, the treant may uproot itself as a secondary action, regaining its movement speed. The treant may not activate this ability again on the following turn.

abilities.name: Wild Charge**
abilities.description: As an all-out action, the treant may charge, doubling the damage it deals until the charge is resolved. While charging this way, the treant is treated as having the Trample technick and is treated as both mount and rider while charging. The treant may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

loot: Mega-Ether (5%), Ammonia Salt (20%), Fae Wood (50%), Magicite (95%)
steal: Remedy (5%), Mandrake Root (25%), Earth Crystal (50%) * Only while rooted. ** Only while uprooted. † Includes 3 points of mighty strikes.
